Draws a frame of an image at a position. The handle of the image, which is its top left corner unless [HandleImage](HandleImage), [MidHandle](MidHandle) or [AutoMidHandle](AutoMidHandle) says otherwise, ends up at the position. Pixels with the mask color of the image (black unless [MaskImage](MaskImage) changed it) are left out, so the picture can have any shape. Drawing is clipped by the viewport, and the [Origin](Origin) moves it.

```blitzbasic
;media still images/drawimage.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local ball = CreateImage(40, 40)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(ball)
Color 255, 120, 0
Oval 0, 0, 40, 40, 1
Color 255, 230, 160
Oval 8, 6, 12, 12, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 7
	DrawImage ball, 20 + i * 36, 100 + Sin(i * 45) * 50
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```

![DrawImage](media/images/drawimage.png)
@param image  The image to draw.
@param x      Horizontal position of the handle of the image.
@param y      Vertical position of the handle of the image.
@param frame  Which frame to draw. Defaults to 0.
@gap A frame number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
